## Summary

I implemented the **actual SP20-D4 capacity mechanism** — not another proposal — as self-contained, additive files over the accepted radix primitive, and delivered the exact wiring API. Auto-rollover is left **disabled with the precise blocker**, transparently using the brief's escape valve rather than shipping untestable wiring into concurrently-edited journal files.

**`internal/daemon/delivery_generation.go`** — an immutable-generation, exact, bounded on-disk membership store in its **own directory** (`<state>/delivery-generations/`), never touching the legacy anchors (no rename-away window). Because the radix is path-copy, the **latest root is a complete superset index over every nonce ever leased** → bounded memory + O(log n) disk lookup across **arbitrarily many generations** (not a 64-segment cap). It keys nonce→full-lease (all identity fields), session→last-arrival (dormant continuity), and (session,arrival)→nonce (ordered access). A commit is radix-insert → chained manifest append+fsync → **atomic head WriteAtomic (single clear point)** → dir fsync; recovery adopts a complete crash-tail and refuses/preserves a torn one. `verifyArchivedAck` re-resolves the original lease and compares **all** identity fields (no unchecked joinOK); missing/corrupt/unknown → unavailable, never a fresh identity; collision → refuse.

**`internal/daemon/delivery_generation_test.go`** — 12 focused tests: 75 generations + replay identity, dormant-session arrival continuity, archived-ACK exact join + corruption refusal, ordered-by-arrival frontier, terminal's archived-lease resolution, restart-after-new-writes, missing-head unavailable, torn-tail preserved+unavailable, complete-tail-adopt after lost head write, empty-store absence, invalid-lease + cancellation.

**`plans/sdd/V6-remediation/delivery-capacity-integration-work.md`** — the exact APIs; how each requirement is met; the **frontier semantics returned to main** (per-session ordered walk provided; a *global* oldest-pending needs the lease↔ack↔terminal join in main's domain — stated, not narrowed); the reader-first/writer-second wiring seam (arrival-seed on open, `decide` miss-path, commit-on-admission, ack/terminal resolution, backup-watch additions); and the unresolved boundaries (unbounded storage is the intended trade; bounded memory/lookups achieved).

**Run status (retained failure, tests did not run):** `run.py capacity-integration-gen-01 … ./internal/daemon` build-failed **entirely in `internal/store`** (`obsBinding` undefined; `obsCommitted`/`obsPending` fields missing — the observation-sidecar author's in-flight edit). My four files are named nowhere in the log (grep 0) and are pinned-gofumpt clean. Per the brief, a compile break in another author's file is incomplete, not a pass; **I do not report compile as evidence and claim no PASS** — re-run once `internal/store` compiles. No commits, config, or edits to co-authored/forbidden files.
